claims.name: HeaderCodecProofs.encode_length_overflow_iff
claims.statement: ∀ (h : Header), HeaderCodec.encode h = EncodeResult.lengthOverflow ↔ h.flags.toNat < 4 ∧ 65536 ≤ h.length.toNat

claims.name: HeaderCodecProofs.encode_parse_roundtrip
claims.statement:
∀ (q : ByteQuad),
  q.b0 = 1 →
    q.b1.toNat < 4 → ∃ h, HeaderCodec.parse q = ParseResult.parsed h ∧ HeaderCodec.encode h = EncodeResult.encoded q

claims.name: HeaderCodecProofs.encode_success_iff
claims.statement:
∀ (h : Header) (q : ByteQuad),
  HeaderCodec.encode h = EncodeResult.encoded q ↔
    h.flags.toNat < 4 ∧
      h.length.toNat < 65536 ∧
        q.b0 = 1 ∧ q.b1 = h.flags ∧ q.b2.toNat = h.length.toNat / 256 ∧ q.b3.toNat = h.length.toNat % 256

claims.name: HeaderCodecProofs.parse_encode_roundtrip
claims.statement:
∀ (h : Header),
  h.flags.toNat < 4 →
    h.length.toNat < 65536 →
      ∃ q, HeaderCodec.encode h = EncodeResult.encoded q ∧ HeaderCodec.parse q = ParseResult.parsed h

claims.name: HeaderCodecProofs.parse_reserved_flags_iff
claims.statement: ∀ (q : ByteQuad), HeaderCodec.parse q = ParseResult.reservedFlags ↔ q.b0 = 1 ∧ 4 ≤ q.b1.toNat

claims.name: HeaderCodecProofs.parse_success_iff
claims.statement:
∀ (q : ByteQuad) (h : Header),
  HeaderCodec.parse q = ParseResult.parsed h ↔
    q.b0 = 1 ∧ q.b1.toNat < 4 ∧ h.flags = q.b1 ∧ h.length.toNat = q.b2.toNat * 256 + q.b3.toNat

claims.name: HeaderCodecProofs.parsed_length_bound
claims.statement: ∀ (q : ByteQuad) (h : Header), HeaderCodec.parse q = ParseResult.parsed h → h.length.toNat < 65536
